identity.name: Storm Abacus
identity.summary: A dark wood counting frame threaded with brass cloud beads.
identity.description: Costs 3 mana per activation. Deals 10 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 3 spark through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: Its final column measures thunder rather than numbers.

effects.description: Costs 3 mana per activation. Deals 10 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 3 spark through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its lightning trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Copper Cicada, Raincatch Bowl, Spark Ring into Storm Abacus.
